description: What percentile is my x402 API's price in its category? One signed number: where a price sits among this week's priced Bazaar listings with 3+ payers in the same category, with the category's median, p10 and p90, the sample size and a 95% range. Give a category and a price, or your listing's URL. Asked again with its ETag, an unchanged answer is a free 304. Price: $0.001 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $0.001 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

if_none_match.description: Send the answer's ETag back in If-None-Match (over MCP, the if_none_match argument): while the answer is unchanged it comes back as a free 304 Not Modified.
if_none_match.title: If None Match

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

price.description: A price per call in USD
price.title: Price
